mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_type, event_version, aggregate_id, payload, trace_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, claimed_at, enqueued_at, processing_started_at, created_at, published_at, processed_at, last_error FROM tb_outbox_event WHERE ( (status IN ('PENDING', 'ENQUEUED') AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND COALESCE(processing_started_at, claimed_at) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) ) ORDER BY created_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT event_id, event_type, event_version, aggregate_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, published_at, processed_at, last_error FROM tb_outbox_event ORDER BY created_at DESC, event_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT event_id, event_type, event_version, aggregate_id, payload, trace_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, claimed_at, enqueued_at, processing_started_at, created_at, published_at, processed_at, last_error FROM tb_outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW() ORDER BY created_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
